# SimpleLecture

> India's AI-powered online learning platform. Live classes, recorded lectures, mock tests and a 24/7 AI doubt solver for NEET, JEE, CBSE, SSLC and PUC.

Main website: https://simplelecture.com

- [Programs](https://simplelecture.com/programs): all courses and programs
- [About](https://simplelecture.com/about): about SimpleLecture
- [Blog](https://simplelecture.com/blog): study tips and course guides
- [Contact](https://simplelecture.com/contact): contact the team
- [Support](https://simplelecture.com/support): help and support
- [How it works](https://simplelecture.com/how-it-works): how SimpleLecture works
